jobs.description:
Standort : Zürich
Arbeitsmodell: vor Ort / Teilzeit, 70%
Vertragsart: Unbefristeter Vertrag

Reimagine what coffee can be. Reimagine what you can become.

Als Coffee Specialist bei Nespresso begeistern Sie unsere Kund:innen mit Ihrer Leidenschaft für Service und Kaffee. Als erste Ansprechperson in der Boutique erkennen Sie ihre Bedürfnisse und schaffen durch persönliche Beratung ein erstklassiges Markenerlebnis. Das ist Ihre Chance, die Welt des Kaffees mitzugestalten und echten Mehrwert zu schaffen.

So werden Sie als Coffee Specialist einen Unterschied machen

• Sicherstellen eines herzlichen Empfangs und eines angenehmen Erlebnisses für unsere Gäste sowie individuelle Beratung unserer Kundschaft, Durchführung von Kaffeedegustationen und aktiver Verkauf unserer Produkte

• Eigenständige Behebung einfacher Maschinenstörungen sowie Koordination von Reparaturen

• Unterstützung und Beratung des Teams bei technischen Fragestellungen rund um unsere Kaffeemaschinen

• Unterstützung bei der Verwaltung von Ersatzteilen sowie der Bearbeitung technischer Kundenanliegen in Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Servicepartnern

• Erfassung von Bestellungen, Durchführung der Kassenabrechnung sowie sorgfältige Pflege und laufende Aktualisierung der Kundendatei

• Aktiver Beitrag zur Erreichung individueller sowie Boutique-Ziele und zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung des Kundenerlebnisses in der Boutique

Was Sie erfolgreich macht

• Ausbildung oder Berufserfahrung im Retail oder in der Gastronomie

• Ausgeprägte Service- und Kundenorientierung sowie Leidenschaft für Kaffee, Marke und einzigartige Kundenerlebnisse

• Interesse und Freude daran, technische Fragestellungen rund um Kaffeemaschinen zu lösen sowie Ihr Wissen mit Kolleg:innen zu teilen

• Erfahrung in der Schulung, Unterstützung oder fachlichen Begleitung von Kolleg:innen ist von Vorteil

• Flexible, gut organisierte und zuverlässige Persönlichkeit mit ausgeprägtem Teamgeist

• Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse, weitere Sprachen wie Englisch sind ein Plus

• Sie leben unsere WECAN Verhaltensweisen: We Inspire, we Care, we Act, and we Innovate

Was Sie bei Nespresso erwartet

Wir wachsen gemeinsam – in einer Kultur der Wertschätzung, Inklusion und Innovation. Unsere Benefits unterstützen Ihre Entwicklung und Ihr Wohlbefinden:

• Attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte auf eine Vielzahl von Produkten und Dienstleistungen des täglichen Bedarf

• Leistungsorientierter Bonus

• Zusätzliche Ferientage über den gesetzlichen Anspruch hinaus

• Grosszügiger Elternurlaub sowie umfassende Unterstützungsangebote für Familien

• Beitrag zur Gesundheitsversorgung und Zugang zum Employee Assistance Program für Sie und Ihre Familie

• Attraktiver Arbeitgeberbeitrag zur Pensionskasse

• Vielfältige Lern- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten zur Förderung Ihrer beruflichen Weiterentwicklung

Was Sie in unserem Bewerbungsprozess erwartet

Wir setzen uns für einen inklusiven und respektvollen Bewerbungsprozess ein und stellen bei Bedarf gerne angemessene Unterstützung zur Verfügung. Unsere Arbeitsplätze sind vollständig barrierefrei und werden durch eine starke Sicherheitskultur unterstützt, mit modernen Einrichtungen und Prozessen, die ein sicheres Umfeld für alle gewährleisten.

Der Bewerbungsprozess umfasst in der Regel ein Videointerview mit Talent Acquisition, ein Gespräch mit dem Fachbereich sowie ein abschließendes Gespräch mit Angebot. Wir prüfen eingehende Bewerbungen fortlaufend und schließen die Stelle, sobald wir eine überzeugende Auswahl geeigneter Kandidat:innen identifiziert haben – daher empfehlen wir eine frühzeitige Bewerbung. Alle Informationen werden vertraulich behandelt.

Bleiben Sie aufmerksam: Nestlé nimmt mit Bewerber:innen ausschliesslich über offizielle E-Mail-Adressen des Unternehmens Kontakt auf und wird Sie zu keinem Zeitpunkt im Bewerbungsprozess um Zahlungen oder die Angabe sensibler persönlicher Informationen bitten.

Bereit, gemeinsam zu wachsen?

Bewerben Sie sich jetzt und gestalten Sie neu, was Sie werden können.

In welcher Funktion auch immer – Sie können echte Veränderungen bewirken und andere für Ihre Ideen begeistern. Bei Nespresso werden Sie aufblühen und sich zugehörig fühlen. Wir inspirieren Sie, sich persönlich weiterzuentwickeln und Ihr Bestes zu geben.

Reimmagina cosa può essere il caffè. Reimmagina cosa puoi diventare.

Essere uno specialista di caffè a Nespresso Sei il nostro cliente: donne con la tua passione per il servizio e il caffè. Come prima persona di contatto nella boutique, riconoscerete le loro esigenze e creare un'esperienza di marca di prima classe attraverso consigli personali. Questa è la tua occasione per contribuire a plasmare il mondo del caffè e creare valore aggiunto reale.

Questo è come uno specialista di caffè farà la differenza

• Garantire un'accoglienza calorosa e una piacevole esperienza per i nostri ospiti e consigli individuali ai nostri clienti, condurre degustazioni di caffè e vendere attivamente i nostri prodotti

• Riparazione indipendente di semplici guasti della macchina e coordinamento delle riparazioni

• Supporto e consulenza del team in questioni tecniche relative alle macchine da caffè

• Sostegno alla gestione dei pezzi di ricambio e alla gestione delle preoccupazioni dei clienti tecnici in collaborazione con i nostri partner di assistenza

• Registrazione degli ordini, esecuzione della fattura in contanti e manutenzione attenta e aggiornamento continuo del file cliente

• Contributo attivo al raggiungimento di obiettivi individuali e boutique e al continuo miglioramento dell'esperienza del cliente nella boutique

Cosa ti fa avere successo

• Formazione o esperienza professionale nella vendita al dettaglio o nella gastronomia

• Forte servizio e orientamento al cliente e passione per il caffè, il marchio e le esperienze di cliente uniche

• Interessi e piacere nella risoluzione di domande tecniche sulle macchine da caffè e nella condivisione delle tue conoscenze con i colleghi:

• Esperienza nella formazione, supporto o supporto professionale dei colleghi: dentro è un vantaggio

• Personalità flessibile, ben organizzata e affidabile con un forte spirito di squadra

• Conoscenza negoziabile del tedesco, altre lingue come l'inglese sono un plus

• Noi ispire, Noi Care, Noi agire, e noi innovare

Cosa aspettarsi da Nespresso

Cresciamo insieme – in una cultura di apprezzamento, inclusione e innovazione. I nostri vantaggi supportano lo sviluppo e il benessere:

• Sconti interessanti sui dipendenti su una varietà di prodotti e servizi di necessità quotidiane

• Bonus basato sulle prestazioni

• Giorni festivi aggiuntivi oltre il diritto legale

• Generoso congedo parentale e servizi di supporto completo per le famiglie

• Contribuire all'assistenza sanitaria e l'accesso al programma di assistenza per i dipendenti per te e la tua famiglia

• Contributo del datore di lavoro attraente al fondo pensione

• Diverse opportunità di apprendimento e sviluppo per promuovere il vostro sviluppo professionale

Cosa aspettarsi nel nostro processo di applicazione

Ci impegniamo a un processo di applicazione inclusivo e rispettoso e siamo lieti di fornire un supporto adeguato, se necessario. I nostri luoghi di lavoro sono completamente accessibili e supportati da una forte cultura della sicurezza, con strutture e processi moderni che garantiscono un ambiente sicuro per tutti.

Il processo di applicazione di solito include un'intervista video con Talent Acquisition, un'intervista con il dipartimento e un'intervista finale con Offer. Rivediamo continuamente le applicazioni in arrivo e chiudiamo la posizione non appena abbiamo identificato una selezione convincente di candidati idonei – quindi raccomandiamo una domanda anticipata. Tutte le informazioni sono trattate come riservate.

Stai attento: Nestlé contatta i candidati esclusivamente attraverso gli indirizzi e-mail ufficiali della società e non ti chiederà mai di pagare o fornire informazioni personali sensibili durante il processo di applicazione.

Pronti a crescere insieme?

Applicare ora e ridisegnare ciò che si può diventare.

In qualsiasi capacità – È possibile fare cambiamenti reali e ottenere gli altri entusiasti circa le vostre idee. A Nespresso fiorirete e sentirete appartenenza. Vi invitiamo a sviluppare personalmente e fare del vostro meglio.

Reimagine what coffee can be. Reimagine what you can become.

Being a Coffee Specialist at Nespresso You are our customer: women with your passion for service and coffee. As the first contact person in the boutique, you will recognize their needs and create a first-class brand experience through personal advice. This is your chance to help shape the world of coffee and create real added value.

This is how you as a coffee specialist will make a difference

• Ensuring a warm welcome and a pleasant experience for our guests as well as individual advice to our customers, conducting coffee tastings and actively selling our products

• Independent repair of simple machine faults and coordination of repairs

• Support and advice of the team in technical issues related to our coffee machines

• Support in the management of spare parts and the handling of technical customer concerns in cooperation with our service partners

• Recording of orders, execution of cash invoice and careful maintenance and ongoing updating of the customer file

• Active contribution to the achievement of individual and boutique goals and to the continuous improvement of the customer experience in the boutique

What makes you successful

• Training or professional experience in retail or gastronomy

• Strong service and customer orientation as well as passion for coffee, brand and unique customer experiences

• Interest and pleasure in solving technical questions about coffee machines as well as sharing your knowledge with colleagues:

• Experience in training, support or professional support of colleagues: inside is an advantage

• Flexible, well organized and reliable personality with a strong team spirit

• Negotiable knowledge of German, other languages such as English are a plus

• We Inspire, We Care, We Act, and We Innovate

What to expect at Nespresso

We grow together – in a culture of appreciation, inclusion and innovation. Our benefits support your development and well-being:

• Attractive employee discounts on a variety of products and services of daily needs

• Performance based bonus

• Additional holiday days beyond the legal entitlement

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive support services for families

• Contributing to health care and access to the Employee Assistance Program for you and your family

• Attractive employer contribution to the pension fund

• Diverse learning and development opportunities to promote your professional development

What to expect in our application process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful application process and are happy to provide appropriate support if necessary. Our workplaces are completely accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern facilities and processes that ensure a safe environment for all.

The application process usually includes a video interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the department and a final interview with Offer. We continuously review incoming applications and close the position as soon as we have identified a convincing selection of suitable candidates – therefore we recommend an early application. All information shall be treated as confidential.

Stay attentive: Nestlé contacts applicants exclusively through the company’s official email addresses and will never ask you to pay or provide sensitive personal information during the application process.

Ready to grow together?

Apply now and redesign what you can become.

In whatever capacity – You can make real changes and get others excited about your ideas. At Nespresso you will flourish and feel belonging. We inspire you to develop personally and do your best.

jobs.title: Digital Process Design Engineer
jobs.description:
Location: Konolfingen, Switzerland
Work model: Office-based
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet

As a Digital Process Design Engineer at Nestlé Product & Technology Center Nutrition & Health, your mission is to develop, standardize and govern process engineering drawings and digital plant models that enable safe, efficient and reusable solutions for nutrition industrialization projects. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with process and automation engineers, project managers, factory teams and equipment suppliers. This is your opportunity to take ownership, grow your expertise, and deliver meaningful results that make a difference at scale.

How you’ll make an impact as a Digital Process Design Engineer

• Developing accurate process diagrams, equipment layouts and three-dimensional plant models that turn engineering concepts into implementation-ready designs.

• Standardizing modular design components, drawing libraries and templates to improve quality, consistency and reuse across global projects.

• Reviewing supplier drawings and digital models to identify clashes and strengthen safety, hygiene, operability, maintainability and accessibility.

• Delivering basic engineering solutions for defined process units, including layouts, equipment interfaces, utility needs and technical specifications.

• Managing engineering data and synchronized digital plant information so teams can find, trust and use current documentation throughout the project lifecycle.

• Driving continuous improvement in design workflows and standards while sharing practical drafting knowledge with engineers, factories and suppliers.

What will make you successful

• Bringing strong two-dimensional and three-dimensional drafting capability for process plants, equipment layouts and engineering documentation.

• Applying computer-aided design tools, ideally including AutoCAD, Plant 3D and Inventor, to create precise and reusable design solutions.

• Using knowledge of process equipment, piping, utilities, instrumentation and hygienic design to strengthen safe and practical layouts.

• Collaborating proactively with engineers, factory partners and suppliers while managing engineering data, revisions and document standards with care.

• Communicating confidently in English at a good working level.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value.

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to Be a Force for Good?

Apply now and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet.

Essere una forza per il cambiamento buono e accelera che migliora la vita e il pianeta

In qualità di Digital Process Design Engineer presso Nestlé Product & Technology Center Nutrition & Health, la vostra missione è quella di sviluppare, standardizzare e governare i disegni di ingegneria dei processi e i modelli di impianti digitali che consentono soluzioni sicure, efficienti e riutilizzabili per i progetti di industrializzazione della nutrizione. Farete la differenza collaborando a stretto contatto con ingegneri di processo e automazione, project manager, team di fabbrica e fornitori di attrezzature. Questa è la vostra opportunità di prendere la proprietà, crescere la vostra esperienza, e fornire risultati significativi che fanno la differenza in scala.

Come farete un impatto come un Digital Process Design Engineer

• Sviluppare diagrammi di processo accurati, layout di attrezzature e modelli di impianti tridimensionali che trasformano i concetti di ingegneria in progetti pronti all'implementazione.

• Standardizzare componenti di design modulari, disegnare librerie e modelli per migliorare qualità, coerenza e riutilizzo in progetti globali.

• Rivedere disegni dei fornitori e modelli digitali per identificare gli scontri e rafforzare la sicurezza, l'igiene, l'operabilità, la manutenbilità e l'accessibilità.

Location: Lausanne, Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid / Full time 100%

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

As a Lab Data Technology Specialist at Nestlé Research within our Computational Sciences department, you will be responsible for reinforcing our laboratory data foundations to help unlock the full value of the data generated by our scientific instruments and laboratory systems. Sitting at the intersection of science, laboratory data, and modern data engineering, you will leverage latest data technologies and AI for coding tools to transform raw, heterogeneous scientific data into trusted, well-documented, and reusable data assets that accelerate impactful scientific research.

How you’ll make an impact as a Lab Data Technology Specialist

• Partner with laboratory stakeholders. data domain owners, lab business analysts together with data architects and engineers to translate functional requirements into scalable, and well-documented technical solutions, ensuring alignment between scientific workflows and technological capabilities

• Enable new and existing laboratory instruments end to end, from understanding the scientific workflow and data outputs to defining and establishing connectivity and data flow (LIMS, robotics, automation platforms, downstream systems), in collaboration with IT network, security specialists

• Collaborate with internal and external professionals to propose and implement customizations to lab digital platforms used (LIMS, instrument integration, technology specific data processing, metadata capture) in view of efficiency, quality, traceability, and governance by design

• Identify opportunities to increase value of lab data gathered across different sources by leveraging data technologies (data integrations, data warehousing, automated data quality checks, etc)

• Support testing, deployment, change management, and continuous improvement of compliant, scalable lab solutions, including AI-enabled opportunities to strengthen data flows and unlock value from lab data

What will make you successful

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in a scientific or computational discipline (e.g., Chemistry, life sciences, Bioinformatics, Cheminformatics, Data Engineering, Computer Science), or equivalent experience.

• Solid experience in applying data engineering to scientific, laboratory data

• Required technical skills

•

• LIMS customization, data models, and integration.

• Integrating lab instruments, applications, robots, and IoT with reference databases and data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake).

• Solid grasp of the lab solutions ecosystem: ELN, CDS, LES, multi-omics pipelines, IoT-connected equipment, barcode systems, etc.

• Programming (e.g., Python, R, Java, Groovy).

• Data engineering and modeling — ETL/ELT (Airflow, dbt), APIs, orchestration, SQL/NoSQL — with engineering rigor (Git, CI/CD, testing, data quality, observability, reproducibility).

• Nice-to-have technical skills

• Semantic modeling, ontologies, and knowledge graphs (e.g., RDF/SPARQL, biomedical/chemical vocabularies).

• FAIR data implementation, metadata management, and lineage tooling

• Enabling AI/ML and analytics use cases on scientific data

• Domain exposure in chemistry, biology, food, or omics

• Reporting tools (e.g., DASH, Streamlit, Power BI) is an advantage

• Leveraging Agentic AI to automate data engineering activities

• Required non-technical skills

• Strong problem-solving and hands-on mindset

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

• Experience collaborating with external vendors and data professionals and driving delivery through others

• Ability to work in cross-functional and international teams

• Strong organizational and prioritization skills

• Fluent spoken and written English

At Nestlé Research, we place people at the core of everything we do.

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office based roles)

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes a video interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ce qui fera ta réussite dans le rôle

• Déployer des méthodes structurées de planification, de suivi budgétaire et de résolution de problèmes pour renforcer la performance, accompagner le changement et assurer un suivi proactif des indicateurs.

• Contribuer à l’évolution des méthodes de planification, y compris par la création ou l’amélioration d’outils numériques lorsque cela apporte de la valeur.

• Faire preuve de curiosité pour intégrer l’IA dans tes activités et proposer de nouvelles façons de gagner en efficacité, en qualité et en impact.

• Collaborer avec des équipes multidisciplinaires, en restant proche du terrain et en mobilisant les équipes autour d’améliorations concrètes des pratiques de maintenance.

• Communiquer couramment en français et en anglais.

• Faire preuve de courage, de collaboration, de réactivité et de curiosité.

Chez NCH, nous plaçons les personnes au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons.

Nous offrons un ensemble d’avantages compétitif et complet, conçu pour soutenir ta croissance et ton bien-être au travail comme dans ta vie personnelle :

• 5 semaines de vacances

• Participation aux frais de santé et programme d’aide aux employés pour toi et ta famille

• Forte contribution de l’employeur à ton plan de prévoyance

• Congé parental généreux et solutions complètes de soutien à la famille

• Opportunités d’apprentissage et de développement pour faire grandir tes compétences

• Remises attractives pour les employés sur des produits et services du quotidien

Ce à quoi t’attendre dans notre processus de recrutement

Nous nous engageons à offrir une expérience de recrutement inclusive et respectueuse, et nous sommes disponibles pour mettre en place des aménagements raisonnables si nécessaire. Nos lieux de travail sont entièrement accessibles et soutenus par une forte culture sécurité, avec des installations modernes et des procédures visant à garantir un environnement sûr pour toutes et tous.

Le processus de recrutement comprend généralement un premier échange avec la recruteuse, un entretien avec le responsable Maintenance incluant une étude de cas, puis une discussion finale avec le responsable Ingénierie avant une éventuelle offre. Nous examinons les candidatures au fur et à mesure et nous clôturons le poste dès qu’une liste solide de candidat·e·s pertinent·e·s est identifiée ; nous t’encourageons donc à postuler dès que possible. Toutes les informations sont traitées de manière confidentielle.

Location: Lausanne , Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid / Full time
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Be a force for good and grow through experiences that push you further.

As a Nutrition Digital Capabilities Specialist at Société des Produits Nestlé SA, your mission is to turn nutrition data into reliable insights, digital prototypes and reporting capabilities that support Nestlé’s Nutrition, Health and Wellness (NHW) strategy and strengthen the nutritional value of our product portfolio. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with the NHW, Research and Development, IT teams. This is your opportunity to take ownership, grow your expertise, and make a difference at scale.

How you’ll make an impact as a Nutrition Digital Capabilities Specialist

• Leading nutrition data analysis to support portfolio decisions.

• Building automated dashboards and reporting capabilities that improve accuracy, efficiency and visibility across global nutrition data.

• Driving data quality, validation and audit readiness to strengthen confidence in internal and external nutrition reporting.

• Developing digital prototypes and new automated functionalities that make nutrition reporting and benchmarking faster, smarter and easier to use.

• Delivering data-driven knowledge projects with clear plans, strong governance and high-quality scientific outputs.

• Nurturing cross-functional networks to understand business needs, share ideas and build digital nutrition capabilities at scale.

What will make you successful

• Master's degree in a relevant field such as data science, statistics, nutrition, food science or equivalent.

• Bringing strong data analytics skills, ideally applied to nutrition, food data or scientific reporting.

• Proven previous experience, preferably in a food manufacturing or recipe management environment.

• Applying knowledge of recipe management, food regulations, nutrition labelling and data governance to create reliable outputs.

• Using data analysis, visualisation, database querying or programming tools to translate complex data into clear insights.

• Collaborating across functions, influencing with integrity and managing projects to deliver meaningful outcomes.

• Communicating with working proficiency in English.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning.

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes a video interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Ready to grow with us?

Apply now and grow through experiences that push you further.

Lieu : Orbe, Suisse

Entité : Nestlé Suisse S.A.

Envie de piloter un projet concret au cœur de notre système qualité ?

Dans le cadre du déploiement de SenseIT, la solution digitale de Nestlé dédiée à la gestion des évaluations sensorielles, nous recherchons un·e stagiaire capable de piloter ce projet avec une très grande autonomie. Cette solution permet notamment de digitaliser les évaluations sensorielles, de faciliter l’intégration avec SAP, d’accéder à des informations en temps réel et de renforcer la conformité des processus.

Votre mission

Au sein de l’équipe Qualité de la Fabrique Nescafé d’Orbe, vous contribuerez à la digitalisation et à l’amélioration continue de notre système de management de la qualité. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Qualité et opérationnelles et les différentes parties prenantes du site.

Ce stage s’adresse à une personne proactive, structurée et responsable, capable d’organiser son travail, de solliciter les bons interlocuteurs et de faire avancer ses sujets avec un encadrement limité. Le stage est ouvert uniquement aux étudiant·e·s en cours d’étude ou ayant obtenu leur diplôme il y a moins d’une année.

Comment vous créerez de l’impact

• Prendre en charge le projet SenseIT avec un haut niveau d’autonomie, de la compréhension du besoin jusqu’au déploiement de la solution.

• Analyser les pratiques actuelles, identifier les opportunités d’amélioration et proposer des solutions simples, efficaces et adaptées aux besoins opérationnels.

• Collecter, structurer et exploiter les informations nécessaires au projet en s’appuyant sur la documentation, les standards et les parties prenantes.

• Coordonner les échanges avec les différents acteurs, assurer le suivi des actions et contribuer à l’alignement des équipes.

• Tester les solutions, documenter les résultats et développer les standards, procédures et supports garantissant une utilisation durable de l’outil.

• Accompagner les utilisateurs dans l’adoption de la solution et suivre l’avancement du projet à l’aide d’indicateurs de performance.

• Contribuer plus largement à la digitalisation et à l’amélioration continue des processus qualité.

Ce qui fera votre réussite

• Vous suivez une formation supérieure en ingénierie, amélioration continue, systèmes industriels ou dans un domaine similaire ou obtenu votre diplôme il y a moins d’un an.

• Vous faites preuve d’une grande autonomie, de curiosité et d’esprit d’initiative, et savez progresser dans un projet même lorsque toutes les réponses ne sont pas immédiatement disponibles.

• Vous êtes capable de transformer un objectif en plan d’action concret, de définir vos priorités et de mener plusieurs activités en parallèle.

• Vous disposez d’un solide esprit d’analyse et savez rechercher, structurer et synthétiser efficacement l’information.

• Vous êtes rigoureux·se, organisé·e et attentif·ve aux détails.

• Vous savez communiquer avec des interlocuteurs variés et créer une dynamique de collaboration.

• Vous êtes à l’aise avec les outils digitaux et Microsoft Office (dont Copilot) ; une expérience en gestion de données, digitalisation ou visualisation de données constitue un atout.

• Vous communiquez couramment en français ; l’anglais constitue un atout.

• Une connaissance des systèmes de management de la qualité, de l’amélioration continue ou d’un environnement industriel est un avantage.

Prêt·e à relever le défi ? Si vous recherchez un stage durant lequel vous pourrez réellement prendre des responsabilités, gérer votre propre projet et contribuer concrètement à la transformation du système qualité de notre fabrique, cette opportunité est faite pour vous.

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

As a Senior Technician in Micronutrients and Phytochemicals Analytics at Nestlé Research, your mission is to provide high-quality analytical support that helps research and operations teams make confident, science-based decisions. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with scientists, analytical experts, technical teams and partners across Nestlé Research. This is your opportunity to turn ideas into sustainable and innovative solutions for people, pets, and the planet.

How you’ll make an impact as a Senior Technician in Micronutrients and Phytochemicals Analytics

• Delivering reliable analytical data that supports research, product quality and operational decisions.

• Developing and applying sample preparation methods within projects, including approaches for allergens, microparticles, micronutrients and phytochemicals analysis as well as spectroscopic measurements.

• Operating and maintaining advanced analytical equipment to ensure robust, timely and high-quality results.

• Evaluating analytical outcomes critically and turning results into clear insights for project teams and stakeholders.

• Contributing to method development and providing technical assistance to markets, including analytical support for allergen-related topics where the role may require handling or being in direct contact with allergenic food materials.

• Supporting project teams with technical assistance, sample preparation for trace analysis and analytical interpretation to ensure robust delivery of project objectives.

• Sharing expertise with colleagues, apprentices and students to build capability across analytical activities.

What will make you successful

• Bringing a Bachelor’s degree, CFC or equivalent qualification in analytical chemistry or a related field, with solid experience in sample preparation gained in industry or academia.

• Applying hands-on knowledge of allergen analysis and being comfortable working in a laboratory environment where allergenic food materials may be handled, prepared or analyzed, with potential direct contact as part of the role. You will also bring knowledge of spectroscopic measurements such as infrared, Raman or X-ray fluorescence, ideally including microparticle analysis. Knowledge in trace analysis and liquid chromatography is a plus.

• Using good laboratory practices, quality and safety standards to deliver accurate, compliant and trusted results.

• Collaborating with curiosity, analytical rigor and a solution-oriented mindset in diverse technical teams.

• Communicating confidently in English and French.
